capital_events_note: Deposits/withdrawals from the Kraken account log (kraken_state/trade_history.json). amount is in `currency` (the flex wallet holds EUR collateral), not USD. Transfers before the go-live date funded the starting balance.
note: Kraken Futures follower account (dashboard Kraken tab), written by kraken_publish.py. The key names starting mexc_ are the dashboard's field names; the values are Kraken's. Kraken API keys do not expire. starting_capital = flex-wallet equity at the first recorded snapshot. No calendar here on purpose - the dashboard loads the session calendar once, globally.
